limits: Admission bounds the workspace local pending and executing publications, not upstream VFS buffers or caller count.
The initial baseline has no direct queue gauge; held-gate TDD proves the missing 256-entry bound.
Only successful, protocol-valid matched cells can support throughput comparisons.
Trace commit latencies cover commit_chunk only, excluding try_commit; absent histogram samples are unavailable.
Flat-v1 A/B is a compatibility guard and does not establish workspace pressure RSS or metadata p99 acceptance.
Crash recovery probes acknowledged fsync prefixes across mount-process death, not backend power loss.
RSS samples cover the tool/close phase, not the subsequent strict drain or the full process lifetime.
Object PUT bytes count successful logical-upload payloads, not HTTP/TLS or SDK-internal retry traffic.
The slow-Redis candidate exits zero but logs flush timeouts, so it is not accepted for durability/latency.
High-resolution phase intervals and native integer-second comparator intervals are both retained; several native intervals are too wide for the -3% guard.
